mostWorthwhile.text: Building both muscles was most worthwhile: their positions explained how the biceps bends the elbow and the triceps straightens it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding mineral to the second bone was a little repetitive after doing the same thing on the front.

surprise.text: The same kind of muscle cells could have different effects because the muscles pull from different positions around the elbow.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the named slots and goals explained why each part was added.

continue.text: I would probably try another chapter if it offered another clear connection between body structures and what they do, though I would hope for less repetition.
